Some doormats are pillows.

questions.solution:
The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

I. Some bedsheets are doormats. → not follow (Because there is no definite relation given between bedsheets and doormats, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

Normal year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day

As per the question:

1 year and 2 days later is Tuesday, which means the last day of the year is Saturday.

In a normal year first and last days are the same means today is also Saturday.

questions.question: Sisodiya Rajput ruler of Mewar, Amar Singh accepted Mughal services during the reign of _________.
questions.questionHtml: Sisodiya Rajput ruler of Mewar, Amar Singh accepted Mughal services during the reign of _________.
questions.solution: Amar Singh I of Mewar maintained a friendly relationship with the Mughal Empire, particularly with Emperor Jahangir. He accepted their suzerainty to ensure the stability and autonomy of his state. Jahangir was the son of Akbar and Mariam-uz-Zamani, and his reign marked a period of cultural, political, and economic growth in the Mughal Empire. He was succeeded by his third son, Prince Khurram, also known as Shah Jahan. Aurangzeb, the sixth Mughal emperor, is a controversial figure in Indian history due to his strict and often repressive policies. Babur, the founder of the Mughal Empire, laid the foundation for the dynasty's rule in India.

questions.question: D and E are points on the sides AB and AC, respectively, of ΔABC such that DE is parallel to BC and AD ∶ DB = 7 ∶ 9. If CD and BE intersect each other at F. then find the ratio of areas of ΔDEF and ΔCBF.

questions.solution:
AD / AB = DE / BC

= 7 : (7+9) 7 : 16

So  areas of ΔDEF and ΔCBF = 72 : 162

= 49 : 256

questions.question: A and B are equally efficient, and each could individually complete a piece of work in 30 days, if none took any holiday. A and B started working together on this piece of work, but A took a day off after every four days of work, while B took a day off after every five days of work. If the duo had started work on 01 August 2022, on which date was the work completed?
questions.questionHtml: A and B are equally efficient, and each could individually complete a piece of work in 30 days, if none took any holiday. A and B started working together on this piece of work, but A took a day off after every four days of work, while B took a day off after every five days of work. If the duo had started work on 01 August 2022, on which date was the work completed?
questions.solution:
Lets total work in 30 units

The efficiency of A and B both is 30 /30 = 1 unit

In 1st 4 days total work 4 × 2 = 8 units

5th and 6th day 1 unit each respectively.

Total work in 6 days 8+2 = 10units

Total 10 × 3 = 30 units will be done in 6×3 = 18days

So the work will be completed in 18 August 2022

(x + y)2 = (18)2 + 4 ×144

⇒ 900

⇒ x + y = 30

questions.question: A and B can finish a work in 10 days, B and C can finish it in 12 days and C and A can finish in 6 days. In how many days A alone can finish the work?
questions.questionHtml: A and B can finish a work in 10 days, B and C can finish it in 12 days and C and A can finish in 6 days. In how many days A alone can finish the work?
questions.solution:
Let total work is 60 units ( LCM of 6, 10 , and12 and)

The efficiency of A+B  = 60 /10 ⇒ 6 units

The efficiency of B+C = 60 / 12⇒ 5 units

The efficiency of A+C = 60 / 6⇒ 10 units

Total efficiency of A + B + C is (10 + 5 + 6) / 2 = 21/2

The efficiency of A is 21 / 2 - 5 = 11/2 units

The number of days A required is 60 × 2 / 11 = 120 /11 days

What is the difference between the average production of flavour X in 2017 and 2018 and the average production of flavour Y in 2019 and 2020.
questions.solution:
The average production of flavour X in 2017 and 2018 is (20 + 20) / 2 = 20

The average production of flavour Y in 2019 and 2020 is (32 + 20) / 2 = 26

Difference is (26 - 20) × 1000 = 6000 packs

questions.question: A train traveling at 70 km/h crosses another train traveling in the same direction at 34 km/h in 25 seconds. What is the combined length of both the trains (in metres)?
questions.questionHtml: A train traveling at 70 km/h crosses another train traveling in the same direction at 34 km/h in 25 seconds. What is the combined length of both the trains (in metres)?
questions.solution:
Relative speed of two trains is 70 -34 = 36 km/hr

36 km /hr = 36 × 5/18

⇒ 10 meter/sec

The combined length of both the trains is 25 × 10 = 250 meters

questions.question: The following sentence has been divided into three segments, A, B, C. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the segment that contains the error, from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer. Aniket lives (A) / in the small apartment (B) / in the suburbs (C).
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments, A, B, C. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the segment that contains the error, from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Aniket lives (A) / in the small apartment (B) / in the suburbs (C).
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'B'.
 
Key Points
  • Segment A, "Aniket lives," is grammatically correct. It has a proper subject-verb agreement.
  • Segment B, "in the small apartment," contains a minor article usage error. The correct usage should be "in a small apartment" since a specific apartment is not being referred to previously within a given context. We generally use 'the' when we are referring to specific things or instances that both the speaker and listener are aware of.
  • Segment C, "in the suburbs," is grammatically correct as the usage of "in" is appropriate for indicating location.
  • Therefore, the segment containing the error is B.

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

Therefore, the correct sentence should be: 'Aniket lives in a small apartment in the suburbs'.
